name: native-source-index-cache
goal: Bound parsed source blobs to the indexed revision while reusing current blobs

evidence: A shared SourceIndexService retains every parsed blob in its map after successive revision indexes; the reusable unit-index coverage needs a many-revision cache-size assertion.
